- 2026-08-05 [fugu] Root cause of the discoverability miss: the CLI's AKR-C011 error carries help 'run akr init to create one', but the MCP surface drops it — crates/akr-mcp/src/errors.rs builds its diagnostic object with only code and message (no help field), so an agent hitting C011 over MCP sees 'no .akr directory found' with no remedy. Fix: propagate EnvError.help into the MCP diagnostics payload.  `@akr.papercut.root-cause-of-the-discoverability-miss-the-cli/1`
- 2026-08-05 [fugu] Historical-port design gap, recovered from a lost agent session (originally logged in the bpg-rs ledger as bpg.papercut.v-020-s-descendant-commit-freshness-gate-akr/1). A single-commit port of old history validated clean before commit, but once the ledger was committed akr check raised 19 AKR-R022: D-016/V-020's descendant-commit rule wants each completed record's evidence to postdate the record's last content change, which is structurally impossible for a transcription of history whose evidence commits predate the port commit. RESOLVED by D-028 (2026-08-05): a completed record carrying source { kind legacy } waives the descendant-commit comparison only (evidence must still resolve, record result pass, and be a commit the repo has). Ports like bpg-rs and the planned jp2lam go green once re-checked with a D-028 binary and their completed records carry a legacy source block.  `@akr.papercut.historical-port-design-gap-recovered-from-a/1`

- 2026-08-05 [fugu] BUG (needs a decision, D-028 is incomplete): completing a COMMITTED non-legacy milestone always fails akr check with AKR-R022. Proven in a throwaway repo: define milestone (commit A), add evidence, complete + commit (commit B); check then reports 'evidence predates the last content change'. Root cause: last_change_of hashes the full canonical record text (crate::hash::content_hash via canonical_hash_input, which strips only comments), so the completion itself - state proposed->completed plus the acceptance verified_by citations - counts as the newest content change, and any cited evidence necessarily predates it. D-028 waived the descendant comparison only for source { kind legacy }, so ongoing non-legacy milestone completion is structurally impossible to keep green once committed. Fix direction: compute last_change over the milestone's DEFINITIONAL content only (exclude state and acceptance verified_by, and lifecycle/provenance fields like reason), matching D-016's stated intent ('stop a test from 200 commits ago closing a milestone redefined yesterday'). Warrants a D-029 decision + tests in validate/rules.rs and git/last_change_of.  `@akr.papercut.bug-needs-a-decision-d-028-is-incomplete/1`
